title: Ticket token estimates — one JSON estimate per shipped ticket without a run receipt (T-917.5)
description: Files live at .ai/tickets/estimates/<ticket-id>.json — deliberately OUTSIDE .ai/tickets/metrics/: the receipt walkers are deny_unknown_fields over every file there and has_receipt treats ANY file under metrics/<id>/ as a measured receipt, so a colocated estimate would impersonate one (the T-913 violation). source=diff_loc carries loc_changed + derived_from_shas and tokens_estimated must equal loc_changed x factor (factor pinned by docs/platform/token_estimate_factor.md); source=cohort_median carries the WIDENED cohort key actually used ({} = all diff_loc tickets) + cohort_size. Validated by ticket check via xtask/src/estimate_tokens.rs; estimates are never summed with receipts.
